description_en: Kvaylāchi Phalcā is located at the south-western corner of Kvaylāchi, an open square in front of the temple of Mahākāla in Sunāguthi. The Phalcā was rebuilt between 2018-2019 with the financial support of the Barbara and Wilfried Mohr-Foundation, the South Asia Institute at Heidelberg University's post-earthquake relief fund Nepalhelp and local community donations. As is the case with most heritage sites along the main road through this small town south of Patan, this monument, too, is endangered by a national road-widening plan that is currently on hold. If implemented, this plan would lead to the demolition of dozens of houses, historic shrines,phalcāsandcaityas.The structure originally stood on timber columns placed on three of its sides, as well as a rear wall made of brick masonry and mud mortar. A small opening in this wall overlooks a small pond just behind the building. The four-way sloped roof was supported by timber struts that transferred the load on to the wall and the timber posts. The historical photographs of the Phalcā published inPruscha(1975 vol. I, 99) andLöwdin(1985, 4) provide an insight into the architectural features of the original Phalcā.The original structure of Kvaylāchi Phalcā collapsed and a fragile RCC slab was placed above the brick masonry in the early 1990s. This structure was then once again heavily damaged during the 2015 earthquakes. The damaged Phalcā was demolished, and the current structure was built upon the same original foundations. A stone inscription on the Phalcā dates its presence back to NS 903 (1783 CE).The Kvaylachi Phalca has a variety of uses, though its primary function is to provide space for social gatherings.
description_ne: सुनागुथिमा रहेको एउटै मात्र भैरव मन्दिरको अगाडि क्वय्लाछि टोलको दक्षिणपश्चिम कुनामा क्वय्लाछि फल्चा रहेको छ । बार्बारा एण्ड विल्डफिल्ड मोह्र फाउण्डेसन र हाइडेलवर्ग युनिभर्सिटीको साउथ एशिया इन्स्टिच्युटद्वारा संकलित भूकम्प राहत कोषको सहयोगमा सन् २०१८-२०१९ मा यस फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण कार्य सम्पन्न भयो । बाटोको किनारमा रहेका अन्य सम्पदा क्षेत्रजस्तै यो फल्चा पनि बाटो विस्तार गर्ने राष्ट्रिय योजनाको चपेटामा परेको छ, जुन केही समयको लागि रोकिएको छ तर पनि त्यसले दर्जनौँ घर, एतिहासिक मन्दिर, फल्चा र चैत्यलाई भत्काउँदा यसलाई पनि भत्काउने देखिन्छ ।तीन तर्फ काष्ठस्तम्भ र पछाडिपट्टि ईंटाको गाह्रो लगाएर यो फल्चा उठाइएको छ । पछाडिको गाह्रोमा एउटा झ्याल राखिएको छ जसबाट फल्चाको पछाडिपट्टि रहेको सानो पोखरी देखिन्छ । चारैतर्फ भिरालो परेको छानालाई काठका निदालले थामेका छन्  जसले छानाको भारलाई काष्ठस्तम्भ र गाह्रोमा पर्ने गरी वितरण गर्दछ । कार्ल प्रुस्चा (1975 vol. 1, p. 99) र पेर लोडिन (1980, 4) ले खिचेको फोटोले यो फल्चाको मौलिक स्वरूप कस्तो रहेछ भन्ने देखाउँछन् । यस फल्चामा नेसं ९०३ (सन् १७८३) को एउटा शिलालेख पनि सुरक्षित रहेको छ ।सन् १९९० को दशकको सुरुका वर्षमा यो फल्चा भत्कियो र त्यसै वेला ईंटाको गाह्रोमाथि आरसिसि ढलान गरेको छत राखी यसको पुनर्निर्माण गरियो । त्यसपछि सन् २०१५ को भूकम्पले फल्चालाई बेसरी क्षति पुर्यायो अनि क्षतिग्रस्त फल्चालाई भत्काएर पुरानो जगमा नयाँ संरचना खडा गरियो ।वर्षभरि नै विभिन्न समयमा सामाजिक जमघट गर्नका लागि यस फल्चाले स्थान उपलब्ध गराउँदै आएको छ ।
brick_type: dāci apā (conical veneer brick), mā apā (regular fired brick)

references: Sources and references Sources Inscription from NS 903 Details १. ᱒ श्रेयोऽस्तु ।। शुभ ।। श्री कौमारि मयि दारुढा रक्तां २. शिरक्त वाशिनि शक्त क्षविन्द्र मुद्रा च गुह्येश्वरि ३. नमस्तु ते ।। सम्वत ९०३ चैत्रमासे कृष्ण पक्षे ।। प्रतिद्य- ४. न्ति प्र ।। स्वाधि(वि) नक्षेत्रे ।। सुधि योगे ।। शुक्रवासरे ।। थ्व ५ कुन्हु फले दयका दिन जुरो ।। थ्व फल्यस चैत्र ६. शुक्ल पूण्र्णमासि कुन्हु प्र १ चेकन फलेस मत ७. छेयके माल, सियाबजि फं ३, रा कुड १, म्वात कुड ८. १, जाकि फं २ थ्व फलेस दान बिय माल ।। धन्त भा- ९. वो, धजुं भावो, धनश्वर भावो, धनमन भावो, १०. बशिवन्त भावो ।। भागिजनिमयि समुहन थ्व फ ११. ले दयका जुरो ।। थ्व फले सेनसा न्हेनेयात दा- १२. न पितेयात दवखेलकोबु क्रष छि १ ।। त्या १३. धन्त भावो प्रमुषन षुम्हस्यनं दुन्ता जुरो १४. ।। गुथिवो सुन्धभावो, पलिदेव भावो, धन्त १५. भावो, थ्वतेसेन थ्व फले निदान यास्य, दा- १६. न बिसे, प्ररसेषन भाब्य भोज याय जु- १७. रो ।। थ्वते यातकाले उतोतर जुरो ।। शुभ This (Phalcā) Rest house is built in NS 903 (1783 CE). On full moon day of March, the butter lamps are to be lit and distribute beaten rice, soya beans, meat, and rice in this phalcā. The construction of this phalcā was made possible by the donations of Dhanta Bhāva, Dhanju Bhāva, Dhanesśvara Bhāva, Dhanmān Bhāva, Birvanta Bhāava and Bhagijani Maĩ. A piece of land (one and half ropani= 760 sq.m approx.) is donated to renovate the phalcā. In case of any problem guthiyār Sundaha Bhāva, Palidev Bhāva and Dhanta Bhāva will decide , solve the problem and organize a feast. Śuva

historical_events.event_description: The construction of Kvaylāchi Phalcā was made possible by the donations made by several people named in the inscription. These are Dhanta Bhāva, Dhanju Bhāva, Dhaneśvara Bhāva, Dhanmān Bhāva, Bīrvanta Bhāva and Bhagijani Mai. Land was also donated to fund the construction.

Kvaylāchi Phalcā was reconstructed with the support of the Mohr Foundation (Hamburg, Germany) and local donations. The supervision was conducted by heritage architect Padma Sundar Maharjan from Sunāguthi. Many meetings were held with different community stakeholders, politicians, representatives of the Department of Archaeology and the like, because the Kvaylāchi Phalcā is located at a very particular site. This site has long been under contestation due to road widening plans that would demands its - and many other heritage buildings' - demolition. The reconstruction process took substantially longer due to the long process of negotiations. Dozens of meetings were scheduled, ranging from general discussions about the relationship between road widening and heritage reconstruction, the reconstruction procedure as such, and schedules for financial arrangements. The local youth were also much involved in discussing the work plan, as were the ward presidents. Women, too, were involved in the reconstruction process.
